cohort: The study included 985 IVF/ICSI-FET patients, categorized by prior vaginal delivery or prior cesarean section.
finding: Prior cesarean section negatively affects IVF/ICSI-FET pregnancy outcomes, with the presence of cesarean scar defect further increasing premature birth and perinatal complication rates.
mod_finding: Prior cesarean section significantly lowers biochemical pregnancy, implantation, live birth, and clinical pregnancy rates compared to prior vaginal delivery, and the presence of cesarean scar defect further increases rates of premature birth and perinatal complications.
